items.why: Nvidia soars more than 30% as the board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, sparking a stunning rally in chip stocks.
The Nasdaq roars back by 6% and the S&P 500 rebounds 4%, so the fear gauge is collapsing as stocks recover.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq surges 6.5% as Nvidia soars on Huang's return, with the S&P 500 rebounding 4%.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 6.47% and the VIX down 23.88% into the close.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a sharp relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq is up about 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4% as buyers step back in after the slide.
